implementation.reason: The baseline rejects valid persisted Dynamic wire versions 1 and 2 despite already having common recursive value serde.

wire_profiles.1: Legacy ignored VarUInt maximum, count, StringBinary canonical SQL names, mandatory unflagged complete statistics
wire_profiles.2: Count, StringBinary canonical SQL names, mandatory unflagged complete statistics
wire_profiles.3: Native-only FLATTENED; not admitted as persisted structure
wire_profiles.4: Existing V3 binary descriptors and optional statistics flag; default unchanged

implementation.identity: Immutable DynamicStructure retains version and exact V1 legacy maximum through equality/hash, re-encode and Object statistics rebuild. The ignored legacy maximum is not a roster count cap.
implementation.budget: Legacy SQL-name parsing borrows the caller's consumptive aggregate budget and inherited depth; canonical rendering must preserve descriptor equality. Legacy UTF-8 is an admission bound; V3 opaque names remain unchanged.
implementation.publication: Existing WidePartColumn.dynamic_bulk structures map, physical plans, shared statistics and N-column publisher are reused; no new product-specific value codec.
implementation.rollback: Revert the single atomic local feature commit with Git after preserving any later user changes; no push/history rewrite authorized.
